title: External — Sign — payload
description: Have a sui-signer external account sign an allow-listed Sui transaction. The custodian builds the digest; no caller-supplied digest or bytes-to-sign are accepted. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

txBytes.description: The unsigned transaction: BCS-encoded Sui `TransactionData`, standard base64 as Sui tooling emits it. Bounded at 128 KiB decoded, Sui's own transaction size limit.

signature.description: Sui serialized signature, base64: the scheme flag (0x02 for secp256r1), the 64-byte signature and the 33-byte compressed public key.

digest.description: The transaction digest the custodian computed, base58 as Sui displays it, so the caller can match it to the transaction it submits.
